name: Tempester n°39: the exact Tempester version on request (F0 01 28 43 F7 -> F0 01 28 43 a1 a0 b1 b0 c1 c0 d1 d0 F7)
explanation: Dependency: requires n°1 (patch/dump_request.json) for its identity byte sender at 0x9d07a080. Why: the identity reply announces 0x7F2 for every Tempester since 1.5.2.0, so the app could not tell one Tempester from another and guessed the features from its own install record. The identity reply is left byte for byte as it is (the app, tools/tempest_midi.swift and standard identity parsers check its length and fields); the exact version is a separate Tempester request that no existing reader sends. Request F0 01 28 43 F7 on the cable set in System ([address], the only cable the SysEx parser accepts): reply F0 01 28 43 a1 a0 b1 b0 c1 c0 d1 d0 F7 on that cable, version a.b.c.d, each digit N sent as N >> 7 then N & 0x7F (0-16383). One source of truth: the four digits are read at run time from the code of the System screen, the li a0,N words tools/patch_version.py writes ([address], [address], [address], [address]): addiu a0,zero,N gives N, any other word (the compiler's clear a0 that patch_version.py writes for 0) gives 0. Each release therefore announces the number its screens show, without a new patch; a test build that keeps its base's digits announces its base's number. Hook: [routine] reads the command back through its getter [address] at [address] to choose the jump; that call goes to VERSION_REQUEST, which answers 0x43 and returns the command as the getter does, so 0x43 goes on through n°1 (not 40/41) and n°24 (not 42) to the original exit [routine](0), and every other command takes the original path after one load. A machine without n°39 treats 0x43 as an unknown command (start event, then [routine](0)) and does not answer. Main loop only; no RAM; 48 words at 0x9d07b400-0x9d07b4bf. Proof: tools/sim_version_request.py and its counter-proofs; Docs/analyses/feature-identity-mode.md.

edits.why: jal 0x9d07b400 ; [routine]: was "jal [address]" (command getter), made by VERSION_REQUEST; delay slot "nop" kept
addiu sp,sp,-0x20 ; main loop ([routine]). Returns v0 = command, as the getter it replaces
bne t0,t1,0x9d07b464 ; any other command: unchanged
jal 0x9d07a080 ; n°1's sender: byte a0 on the cable set in System ([address]), through [routine]
li a0,0x43 ; the request's own command byte
addiu a0,s0,0x7758 ; digit 1: System screen "li a0,N" (patch_version.py DIGITS)
lbu v0,-0x7f94(gp) ; v0 = command, as the getter: 0x43 then reaches the unknown-command exit, [routine](0)
addiu sp,sp,-0x20 ; DIGIT(a0 = address of a version digit word): sends N >> 7, then N & 0x7F
lw t0,0x0(a0) ; the instruction word, read from the program flash
li t2,0x2404 ; high half of "addiu a0,zero,N" (li a0,N)
or s0,zero,zero ; delay slot: N = 0 for any other word ("clear a0")
andi a0,a0,0x7f ; delay slot: N >> 7, a data byte
